text:
Evan M: heads-up 7 prototyping idea for the Routing Policies editor: a Conflict Resolver panel that shows the simulated input, the single rule that will run, and a ranked list of shadowed rules with quick actions (jump, move winner up, export conflict). want feedback before i mock it. Zoe H: nice. export conflict? what's that for? Evan M: export = csv/clipboard of the simulation + rule ids + conditions so SREs can reproduce locally and for audits. handy for dedicated/private customers. Ravi K: UX notes: keep the panel lightweight. primary action should be "Jump to winner" so users immediately see the rule in context. auto-resolve should be opt-in (dangerous to reorder heuristically). Clara J: copy options for the panel header: "Conflict resolver", "Simulation results", "Ordering insights". prefer "Simulation results" 7 clearer to non-technical. Evan M: tentatively: header = "Simulation results"; subhead = "Rule X will run. 3 other rules match and are shadowed." Zoe H: interaction suggestion: add a small inline "why" chevron next to each shadowed rule that expands the matching condition in plain english and shows a sample input fragment. keeps the main list tidy. Ravi K: accessibility: panel should be focus-trap when opened via keyboard. add aria-role="dialog" and an announcement when the result stabilizes: "Simulation updated: Rule X will execute." debounce 400ms. also expose an accessible shortcut to copy the CSV. Clara J: visual: winner highlight = 2px gold glow; shadowed = muted with hatch pattern overlay for non-color cue. provide a compact legend at top for patterns. Evan M: about auto-resolve heuristics (for a later phase): move the winner above the first blocking rule if it has equal or higher specificity and no downstream side effects. show preview of post-resolve order and require explicit confirm. default off. Thoughts? Zoe H: include undo. always show the deltas in a confirmation modal: "This will move Rule A from position 6 to 2. Confirm?" with undo toast for 10s. Ravi K: validation behavior on save: prefer non-blocking save + banner with quick link to resolver. but provide a tenant setting to enforce strict ordering that blocks save (enterprise). banner copy: "Saved. 2 rules are shadowed. Open Simulation results to review." Clara J: microcopy for the quick-action buttons: - Jump: "Open in list" - Move up: "Move winner above blocker" - Export: "Copy conflict CSV" Keep verbs first. accessibility-bot: checklist: focus trap, aria-role=dialog, aria-live for updates (polite), keyboard shortcuts documented, copy-to-clipboard uses aria-live confirmation. Evan M: next steps: i'll drop a low-fi in Figma today. Ravi, can you draft the aria snippet? Zoe, can you mock the CSV columns? Clara, i'll send the palette suggestions. Sync on Wed at 10am. Zoe H: CSV columns i'd include: simulation_id, input_snippet, winner_rule_id, shadowed_rule_ids (semicolon), winner_condition_human, timestamp. ok? Ravi K: aria snippet idea:
Simulation updated: Rule X will execute.
(only write after stable state). Clara J: i'll add a small legend and pattern assets. Evan M: cool thanks 7 i'll post mocks in #product-design when ready and link the PR.
